settings.name: all
settings.label: Show Juggernaut Smash Settings
settings.description: Shows Juggernaut-specific run-through smash controls.

settings.name: juggernautEnabled
settings.label: Enable Juggernaut Smash
settings.description: Master switch for Juggernaut run-through smashing. This control exists only inside Juggernaut mode.

settings.name: juggernautMaxTestSensitivity
settings.label: MAXIMUM TEST SENSITIVITY
settings.description: TEST switch: almost-zero speed gate, long target reach, no center-screen gate/cooldown, 0.02 s sampling, and high minimum vehicle/object impulse so detection is obvious. Turn off after validation to tune normally.

settings.name: juggernautAffectNPCs
settings.label: Smash NPCs
settings.description: Uses SPLAT's proven Look-Triggered Trip actuator for NPCs.

settings.name: customTripOnLook_requireCenterScreen
settings.label: NPC Require Center Screen
settings.description: When off, shoulder/body contact is more forgiving while sprinting through NPCs.

settings.name: customTripOnLook_contactDistM
settings.label: NPC Contact Distance
settings.description: Distance at which the proven OnLook NPC smash can fire.

settings.name: customTripOnLook_minSpeedMps
settings.label: NPC Minimum Run Speed
settings.description: Minimum effective movement speed for NPC smashing.

settings.name: customTripOnLook_pushXY
settings.label: NPC Forward Push
settings.description: Forward impulse from V's movement through the NPC.

settings.name: customTripOnLook_downZ
settings.label: NPC Down Force
settings.description: Downward component applied by the proven NPC OnLook smash.

settings.name: customTripOnLook_sideXY
settings.label: NPC Side Force
settings.description: Side component available to the NPC smash actuator.

settings.name: customTripOnLook_liftZ
settings.label: NPC Lift
settings.description: Upward component available to the NPC smash actuator.

settings.name: customTripOnLook_radius
settings.label: NPC Impulse Radius
settings.description: Ragdoll influence radius for the NPC smash.

settings.name: juggernautAffectVehicles
settings.label: Smash Vehicles
settings.description: Allows Juggernaut to physically shove cars and motorcycles.

settings.name: juggernautAffectObjects
settings.label: Smash Movable / Destructible Objects
settings.description: Sends a physical impulse to looked-at dynamic GameObjects such as supported stands, garbage and breakable street props.

settings.name: juggernautRequireCenterScreen
settings.label: Vehicle / Object Require Center Screen
settings.description: When on, vehicles and props must remain in the forward screen lane.

settings.name: juggernautMinSpeedMps
settings.label: Vehicle / Object Minimum Run Speed
settings.description: Minimum movement speed for vehicle and world-object smashing.

settings.name: juggernautVehicleContactDistM
settings.label: Vehicle Contact Distance
settings.description: Maximum distance to the looked-at vehicle for the Juggernaut shove.

settings.name: juggernautVehiclePush
settings.label: Vehicle Push Strength
settings.description: Horizontal physical impulse in V's movement direction.

settings.name: juggernautVehicleVertical
settings.label: Vehicle Vertical Force
settings.description: Positive values lift vehicles; negative values drive them down.

settings.name: juggernautVehicleRadius
settings.label: Vehicle Impulse Radius
settings.description: Physical impulse radius for cars and motorcycles.

settings.name: juggernautVehicleMassCompensation
settings.label: Vehicle Mass Compensation
settings.description: Scales the vehicle shove for heavier vehicles without reading bullet or explosion settings.

settings.name: juggernautObjectContactDistM
settings.label: World Object Contact Distance
settings.description: Maximum distance to a looked-at dynamic/destructible GameObject.

settings.name: juggernautObjectPush
settings.label: World Object Push Strength
settings.description: Horizontal physical impulse for supported movable/destructible props.

settings.name: juggernautObjectVertical
settings.label: World Object Vertical Force
settings.description: Vertical component of the world-object physical impulse.

settings.name: juggernautObjectRadius
settings.label: World Object Impulse Radius
settings.description: Physical impulse radius for movable/destructible props.

settings.name: juggernautCooldownSec
settings.label: Vehicle / Object Smash Cooldown
settings.description: Prevents repeated impulses on the same pass.

settings.name: juggernautIntervalSec
settings.label: Vehicle / Object Detection Interval
settings.description: Sampling interval for the Juggernaut vehicle/object detector.
